---
title: "Lab members only"
subtitle: "Shared folder for EnGeL members"
---

Some lab documents are not published on this website because they contain names, live records or internal procedures. They are kept in the lab's shared folder, which opens only for lab members who have been given access.

**Shared folder:** [EnGeL shared folder (Google Drive)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_-ijsFKCi6xN1OJ2jtHJ99V1Sn3ne6WI?usp=drive_link)

What you find there:

- *Welcome and Onboarding Handbook* and *Lab Guide*
- Equipment logbooks, user logs and the thermocycler planner
- Equipment service and verification records
- Sample register (freezers) and the sample master data
- Lab resources library: external protocols and kit manuals, primers, bioinformatics, courses, writing and images

To request access, use the lab contact on any protocol page.
